title: Adding the correct NSW Driver Licence to your MyServiceNSW Account and the Service NSW app
summary: Learn how to remove and re-add your correct NSW driver licence and vehicle registrations to your MyServiceNSW Account and the Service NSW app.

how_to_steps.text: Log out of the Service NSW app.
Go to Remove services in your account on the website (not in the app). Note: You’ll be prompted to log in first.
Select ‘Remove NSW driver licence and vehicle registrations’ and follow the prompts.
After you've followed the steps to remove the incorrect driver licence, go to 'Add services' and select ‘NSW driver licence and vehicle registrations’ in your account.
Follow the prompts to add your licence using your own details.
After you have successfully added your licence, you can log back in to the app.

faqs.q: What happens if I remove an incorrect driver licence?
faqs.a: Removing the current licence will also remove any associated demerit information and vehicle registrations.

faqs.q: How do I add my correct driver licence?
faqs.a: After removing the incorrect licence, follow the steps to add your licence again. This process will add your demerit information and any vehicle registrations.
